_schema.description: Traffic-Sign ADAS Copilot - knowledge base. One entry per GTSRB class (0-42). Each entry is retrieved by class_id, embedded into vectors, and used by the LLM to generate a grounded explanation. Keep 'rule' and 'context' factual and concise; the LLM will paraphrase them.

fields.name: short human-readable sign name
fields.category: one of: speed_limit, prohibition, mandatory, warning, priority, other
fields.rule: the traffic rule the sign imposes, in plain English (1-2 sentences)
fields.context: when/where this sign is typically placed (1 sentence)
fields.typical_danger: the risk the sign warns about or the behavior it prevents (1 sentence)
fields.driver_action: what the driver should do concretely (1 sentence, imperative)

_schema.authoring_note: This KB is generic and inspired by international road-sign conventions (Vienna Convention). Cite your local highway code in production. Below are 4 template entries covering each category. Fill in the remaining 39 classes using these as models.

entries.name: Speed limit (20km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 20 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed in very low-speed zones such as shared spaces, car parks, or narrow lanes with heavy pedestrian activity.
entries.typical_danger: Even modest speeds here leave little room to stop for pedestrians who may step into the road unexpectedly.
entries.driver_action: Slow the vehicle to at most 20 km/h before the sign and keep a careful watch for pedestrians.

entries.name: Speed limit (30km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 30 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed in urban areas, near schools, residential zones, or road works where lower speeds are required for safety.
entries.typical_danger: Higher speeds increase stopping distance and the severity of collisions with pedestrians or cyclists.
entries.driver_action: Slow the vehicle to at most 30 km/h before passing the sign and maintain that speed.

entries.name: Speed limit (50km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 50 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: The typical default limit inside built-up areas, marking the start of an urban speed zone.
entries.typical_danger: Exceeding the urban limit sharply increases stopping distance and the risk to pedestrians and cyclists.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed to at most 50 km/h before the sign and maintain it through the built-up area.

entries.name: Speed limit (60km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 60 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed on transition roads between urban and rural areas, or on approaches with reduced safety margins.
entries.typical_danger: Carrying higher speed into bends or junctions on these roads reduces the time available to react.
entries.driver_action: Adjust speed to at most 60 km/h before the sign and stay alert for changing conditions.

entries.name: Speed limit (70km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 70 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed on rural roads or main arteries where a moderate speed is safe but the open-road limit is not.
entries.typical_danger: Higher speeds lengthen braking distance for oncoming traffic, junctions, or slow vehicles ahead.
entries.driver_action: Keep the vehicle at or below 70 km/h and increase your following distance.

entries.name: Speed limit (80km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 80 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: A common limit on rural highways and dual-carriageway approaches outside built-up areas.
entries.typical_danger: At this speed, loss of control or a late reaction to hazards can have severe consequences.
entries.driver_action: Maintain a speed of at most 80 km/h and keep a safe gap to the vehicle ahead.

entries.name: End of speed limit (80km/h)
entries.rule: The previously posted 80 km/h limit no longer applies; the general limit for the road now takes effect.
entries.context: Placed at the end of an 80 km/h restriction zone to signal a return to the default limit.
entries.typical_danger: Assuming the road is now unrestricted may lead to unsafe speeds if a lower general limit still applies.
entries.driver_action: Resume the general limit for the road type and continue to adjust speed to the conditions.

entries.name: Speed limit (100km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 100 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed on expressways or motorway sections where higher travel speeds are permitted.
entries.typical_danger: High closing speeds leave very little margin for sudden braking or lane changes ahead.
entries.driver_action: Keep at or below 100 km/h, maintain a large following distance, and check mirrors before manoeuvres.

entries.name: Speed limit (120km/h)
entries.rule: You must not exceed 120 km/h until the limit is cancelled or a new limit is posted.
entries.context: Placed on motorways where the highest permitted travelling speed applies.
entries.typical_danger: At motorway speeds, stopping distances are long and even small errors escalate quickly.
entries.driver_action: Stay at or below 120 km/h, keep well back from the vehicle ahead, and signal early for lane changes.

entries.name: No passing
entries.rule: Overtaking other motor vehicles is prohibited from this sign until the restriction is lifted.
entries.context: Placed where sight distance is limited, such as bends, crests, or narrowing roads.
entries.typical_danger: Overtaking here risks a head-on collision with oncoming traffic hidden by the limited sight line.
entries.driver_action: Do not overtake; stay in your lane until an end-of-no-passing sign or clear markings permit it.

entries.name: No passing for vehicles over 3.5 metric tons
entries.rule: Vehicles with a permitted mass over 3.5 tonnes must not overtake from this sign until the restriction is lifted.
entries.context: Placed on gradients or narrow sections where slow, heavy vehicles overtaking would obstruct traffic.
entries.typical_danger: A heavy vehicle overtaking slowly blocks lanes and creates long queues and passing conflicts.
entries.driver_action: If driving a vehicle over 3.5 tonnes, remain in lane and do not attempt to overtake.

entries.name: Right-of-way at the next intersection
entries.rule: You have priority over traffic on the crossing road at the next intersection.
entries.context: Placed on the approach to a junction where the crossing road must give way to you.
entries.typical_danger: Relying on priority without checking can be dangerous if a crossing driver fails to yield.
entries.driver_action: Proceed with your priority but stay alert and be ready to brake if crossing traffic does not stop.

entries.name: Priority road
entries.rule: You are on a priority road and have right of way at its intersections until an end-of-priority sign appears.
entries.context: Placed along main routes to indicate continuing priority over side roads.
entries.typical_danger: Drivers entering from side roads may misjudge your speed and pull out into your path.
entries.driver_action: Keep your priority but watch side roads for vehicles that may fail to give way.

entries.name: Yield
entries.rule: You must give way to traffic on the road you are entering or crossing, stopping if necessary.
entries.context: Placed at junctions where the crossing or main road has priority.
entries.typical_danger: Entering without yielding causes collisions with vehicles that have the right of way.
entries.driver_action: Slow down on approach, give way to priority traffic, and proceed only when the way is clear.

entries.name: Stop
entries.rule: You must come to a complete stop at the stop line (or before the intersection if no line is present) and give way to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.
entries.context: Placed at intersections where visibility is limited or where the crossing road has clear priority.
entries.typical_danger: Rolling through the sign without stopping causes broadside collisions with vehicles on the priority road.
entries.driver_action: Bring the vehicle to a full stop, look in all directions, and only proceed when the intersection is clear.

entries.name: No vehicles
entries.rule: Entry is prohibited for all vehicles in both directions from this sign.
entries.context: Placed at the entrance to pedestrian zones or areas closed to general traffic.
entries.typical_danger: Entering a closed area endangers pedestrians and other permitted users who do not expect vehicles.
entries.driver_action: Do not enter; find an alternative route unless you belong to an explicitly exempt category.

entries.name: Vehicles over 3.5 metric tons prohibited
entries.rule: Vehicles with a permitted mass over 3.5 tonnes must not proceed beyond this sign.
entries.context: Placed on roads, bridges, or zones unsuitable for heavy vehicles due to weight or size limits.
entries.typical_danger: A heavy vehicle on an unsuitable road risks damaging bridges or getting stuck in narrow sections.
entries.driver_action: If your vehicle exceeds 3.5 tonnes, do not proceed and take the designated diversion.

entries.name: No entry
entries.rule: Entry is prohibited for all vehicles in the direction the sign faces.
entries.context: Placed at the exit of one-way streets or restricted carriageways to prevent wrong-way driving.
entries.typical_danger: Entering here means driving against oncoming one-way traffic, a high risk of head-on collision.
entries.driver_action: Do not enter; continue past and use a permitted entrance instead.

entries.name: General caution
entries.rule: Warns of a hazard ahead not covered by a more specific sign; heightened attention is required.
entries.context: Placed before a section with an unusual or unmarked danger.
entries.typical_danger: An unexpected hazard can catch an inattentive driver with too little time to react.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, stay alert, and be ready to respond to whatever hazard appears.

entries.name: Dangerous curve to the left
entries.rule: Warns of a sharp curve to the left ahead; adjust speed before entering it.
entries.context: Placed ahead of a left bend tight enough to require slowing down.
entries.typical_danger: Entering the curve too fast risks running wide or losing traction.
entries.driver_action: Slow down before the bend and steer smoothly through it without braking hard mid-curve.

entries.name: Dangerous curve to the right
entries.rule: Warns of a sharp curve to the right ahead; adjust speed before entering it.
entries.context: Placed ahead of a right bend tight enough to require slowing down.
entries.typical_danger: Entering the curve too fast risks crossing into the opposite lane or leaving the road.
entries.driver_action: Slow down before the bend and steer smoothly through it without braking hard mid-curve.

entries.name: Double curve
entries.rule: Warns of two successive curves ahead; reduce speed and be ready to change direction twice.
entries.context: Placed before a pair of bends in opposite directions with little straight road between them.
entries.typical_danger: Carrying too much speed into the first bend leaves no time to set up for the second.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed before the first curve and stay controlled through both bends.

entries.name: Bumpy road
entries.rule: Warns of an uneven road surface ahead; reduce speed to keep control.
entries.context: Placed before sections with bumps, dips, or a damaged surface.
entries.typical_danger: Bumps taken at speed can unsettle the vehicle, reduce grip, or damage the suspension.
entries.driver_action: Slow down before the rough section and keep a firm hold on the wheel.

entries.name: Slippery road
entries.rule: Warns that the road may be slippery ahead; reduce speed and avoid sudden inputs.
entries.context: Placed where the surface can lose grip due to ice, rain, mud, or loose material.
entries.typical_danger: Braking, accelerating, or steering sharply on a slippery surface can cause skidding.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed early, brake and steer gently, and increase your following distance.

entries.name: Road narrows on the right
entries.rule: Warns that the carriageway narrows from the right ahead; adjust your position if needed.
entries.context: Placed before a point where the road or the right-hand lane becomes narrower.
entries.typical_danger: Failing to adjust position can lead to sideswipe conflicts as the space reduces.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, check your right side, and adjust lane position for the narrower road.

entries.name: Road work
entries.rule: Warns of construction or maintenance ahead; adapted speed and heightened attention are required until the end of the works.
entries.context: Placed before road-work zones, temporary lane closures, or areas with workers, equipment, or uneven surfaces.
entries.typical_danger: Unexpected obstacles, workers on the roadway, sudden lane shifts, and loose gravel can cause loss of control.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, increase following distance, and be ready to stop; do not overtake within the works zone.

entries.name: Traffic signals
entries.rule: Warns of traffic lights ahead; be prepared to stop when signalled.
entries.context: Placed before a signal-controlled junction, often where the lights are not visible far in advance.
entries.typical_danger: Approaching too fast risks running a red light or making a sudden hard stop.
entries.driver_action: Ease off the accelerator on approach and be ready to stop at the signal.

entries.name: Pedestrians
entries.rule: Warns of a pedestrian crossing or an area with pedestrians ahead; give way as required.
entries.context: Placed before crossings or stretches where pedestrians frequently enter the road.
entries.typical_danger: Pedestrians may step onto the road with little warning, leaving short reaction time.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, scan both sides, and be ready to stop for anyone crossing.

entries.name: Children crossing
entries.rule: Warns of an area with children ahead, such as near a school; extra caution is required.
entries.context: Placed near schools, playgrounds, or residential zones with frequent child activity.
entries.typical_danger: Children may run into the road unpredictably and are hard to see between parked vehicles.
entries.driver_action: Slow right down, watch the roadside closely, and be prepared to stop immediately.

entries.name: Bicycles crossing
entries.rule: Warns of a cycle crossing or route ahead where cyclists may join or cross the road.
entries.context: Placed where a cycle path meets or crosses the carriageway.
entries.typical_danger: Cyclists can appear quickly from the side and are easily missed in blind spots.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, check for cyclists on both sides, and give way where required.

entries.name: Beware of ice/snow
entries.rule: Warns that the road may be icy or snow-covered ahead; reduce speed and drive gently.
entries.context: Placed on shaded, exposed, or high-altitude sections prone to ice and snow.
entries.typical_danger: Ice or packed snow drastically reduces grip, greatly increasing stopping distance.
entries.driver_action: Slow down well in advance, avoid sudden braking or steering, and leave a large gap ahead.

entries.name: Wild animals crossing
entries.rule: Warns that wild animals may cross the road ahead; stay alert, especially at dawn and dusk.
entries.context: Placed on rural roads through forests or open country where animals frequently cross.
entries.typical_danger: An animal entering the road suddenly can cause a collision or a dangerous swerve.
entries.driver_action: Reduce speed, scan the roadsides, and brake in a straight line rather than swerving if an animal appears.

entries.name: End of all speed and passing limits
entries.rule: All previously posted speed and overtaking restrictions are cancelled; the general rules for the road now apply.
entries.context: Placed at the end of a restricted section to lift the earlier limits.
entries.typical_danger: Accelerating without regard for conditions can be unsafe even where restrictions have ended.
entries.driver_action: Return to the general limits for the road and continue to adapt speed to the conditions.

entries.name: Turn right ahead
entries.rule: You must turn right ahead; other directions are not permitted at this point.
entries.context: Placed before a junction where traffic is directed to the right only.
entries.typical_danger: Ignoring the instruction causes conflicts with a layout and traffic that assume a right turn.
entries.driver_action: Signal and prepare to turn right, positioning the vehicle correctly in advance.

entries.name: Turn left ahead
entries.rule: You must turn left ahead; other directions are not permitted at this point.
entries.context: Placed before a junction where traffic is directed to the left only.
entries.typical_danger: Ignoring the instruction causes conflicts with oncoming or crossing traffic.
entries.driver_action: Signal and prepare to turn left, positioning the vehicle correctly in advance.

entries.name: Ahead only
entries.rule: You must continue straight ahead; turning left or right at this point is not permitted.
entries.context: Placed at intersections where turns are restricted to preserve traffic flow or prevent conflicts with priority lanes.
entries.typical_danger: Attempting a turn against this instruction causes conflicts with oncoming or crossing traffic.
entries.driver_action: Continue straight through the intersection and do not attempt to turn.

entries.name: Go straight or right
entries.rule: You must continue straight ahead or turn right; turning left is not permitted.
entries.context: Placed at junctions where the left turn is closed to preserve traffic flow.
entries.typical_danger: Attempting a left turn conflicts with the permitted movements and other road users.
entries.driver_action: Choose to go straight or turn right, and signal your intended direction.

entries.name: Go straight or left
entries.rule: You must continue straight ahead or turn left; turning right is not permitted.
entries.context: Placed at junctions where the right turn is closed to preserve traffic flow.
entries.typical_danger: Attempting a right turn conflicts with the permitted movements and other road users.
entries.driver_action: Choose to go straight or turn left, and signal your intended direction.

entries.name: Keep right
entries.rule: You must pass to the right of the sign or obstacle it marks.
entries.context: Placed at traffic islands, obstructions, or lane divisions to direct traffic to the right.
entries.typical_danger: Passing on the wrong side risks a collision with oncoming or dividing traffic.
entries.driver_action: Steer to the right of the marked point and keep to the correct side.

entries.name: Keep left
entries.rule: You must pass to the left of the sign or obstacle it marks.
entries.context: Placed at traffic islands, obstructions, or lane divisions to direct traffic to the left.
entries.typical_danger: Passing on the wrong side risks a collision with oncoming or dividing traffic.
entries.driver_action: Steer to the left of the marked point and keep to the correct side.

entries.name: Roundabout mandatory
entries.rule: You must proceed around the roundabout in the direction shown, giving way as required on entry.
entries.context: Placed at the approach to a roundabout to indicate the mandatory circulating direction.
entries.typical_danger: Entering without yielding or taking the wrong direction causes conflicts with circulating traffic.
entries.driver_action: Give way to traffic already on the roundabout, then enter and follow the indicated direction.

entries.name: End of no passing
entries.rule: The earlier no-overtaking restriction ends; overtaking is again permitted where it is otherwise safe and legal.
entries.context: Placed at the end of a no-passing section to lift the restriction.
entries.typical_danger: Overtaking immediately without checking the road ahead can still be dangerous.
entries.driver_action: Overtake only when you have a clear view and enough space to do so safely.

entries.name: End of no passing by vehicles over 3.5 metric tons
entries.rule: The no-overtaking restriction for vehicles over 3.5 tonnes ends; such vehicles may overtake again where safe and legal.
entries.context: Placed at the end of a section where heavy vehicles were barred from overtaking.
entries.typical_danger: A heavy vehicle overtaking too soon or without a clear view can obstruct traffic and cause conflicts.
entries.driver_action: If driving a vehicle over 3.5 tonnes, overtake only with a clear view and adequate space.
